en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a riverside scene. In the foreground is a calm river with a small boat moored at the bank, stone embankment, and wooden stairs and jetties leading up the slope. On the hill above the river stand leafless trees and fenced paths, with several houses and a prominent church featuring a tall tower and onion-shaped spire dominating the background. The caption text in red Gothic-style letters appears at the top of the card.
